bio: Situated at the pinnacle of the world’s oldest museum sits the Ashmolean Rooftop Restaurant. Gaze across the imposing Oxford spires whilst enjoying a relaxing Afternoon Tea. The Afternoon Tea served at The Ashmolean Rooftop Restaurant is the perfect accompaniment to the great spectacles and attractions viewable in the great Ashmolean Museum, as it serves as a relaxing solution to digesting the historical wonders on display.  The serving area at The Ashmolean Rooftop Restaurant takes full advantage of the elevated location with floor to ceiling windows surrounding the seating area leading out onto the terrace. The terrace is decorated with lush greenery and is supported for not so favourable whether allowing the Ashmolean Rooftop Restaurant to be a location for Afternoon Tea all year round.  The Afternoon Tea served at Ashmolean Rooftop Restaurant is made fresh by the chefs on the rooftop restaurant and is traditionally presented with options of sweet and savoury dishes.  Each Afternoon Tea is themed to tie in with the current exhibition and is served every day between 11:30am and 4pm (with last orders being at 4pm).  The Ashmolean Rooftop Restaurant is a 12 minute walk from the main Oxford Station.
